note: Rots et al. (2023) note distal skeletal anomalies as defined by OMIM are rare in their cohort, making the specific evaluation of minor digital anomalies plausible.

evidence.text: In an expanded cohort of individuals with KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder, coarse facies and distal skeletal anomalies as defined by OMIM were found to be rare.

source.title: The clinical and molecular spectrum of the KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder
source.quote: Notably, coarse facies and distal skeletal anomalies, as defined by OMIM, are rare in this expanded cohort while other features are unexpectedly common (eg, hypotonia, psychosis, etc.
